column2: How do I reset my student portal password?
column3: Use the forgot password option on the student portal login page and follow the instructions sent to your registered email.

column2: How can I register for courses?
column3: Log in to the student portal and select course registration during the announced registration period.

column2: Where can I see my exam results?
column3: You can view your published examination results through the grades section of the student portal.

column2: How do I get my academic transcript?
column3: Contact the university registrar office to request an official academic transcript.

column2: What should I do if I lose my student ID card?
column3: Report the lost ID to the student services office and request a replacement card.

column2: How can I connect to campus Wi-Fi?
column3: Select the campus wireless network and sign in using the credentials provided by university IT support.

column2: How do I borrow books from the library?
column3: Present your valid student ID at the library circulation desk and follow the borrowing rules.

column2: How can I renew a borrowed library book?
column3: Use the library renewal service or contact the circulation desk before the due date.

column2: How can I apply for student housing?
column3: Contact the student housing office and follow the application process during the announced period.

column2: Where can I get help with my university email?
column3: Contact the campus IT help desk for assistance with your university email account.

column2: How do I withdraw from a course?
column3: Consult your academic advisor and submit the required withdrawal request before the deadline.

column2: How can I find my class timetable?
column3: Check the class schedule section of the student portal or contact your department.

column2: What should I do if my grades are incorrect?
column3: Contact your course instructor or department to request a grade review.

column2: How can I access online learning materials?
column3: Log in to the university learning management system using your assigned credentials.

column2: How can I contact my academic advisor?
column3: Contact your department office to obtain your advisor's contact details and consultation schedule.
